target_audience.who_should_take_foundation_first: Individuals not familiar with standard Microsoft 365 apps

prerequisites.required: Proficiency in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
prerequisites.recommended: Basic understanding of generative AI concepts

overview.positioning: Supercharge your daily productivity by mastering AI integration across the Microsoft 365 suite.
overview.short_description: Learn to effectively prompt and utilize Microsoft Copilot in Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Teams to automate tasks and boost creativity.
what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Draft, summarize, and edit complex documents in Word using AI
Generate formulas, analyze trends, and visualize data in Excel with plain English
Instantly create professional presentations in PowerPoint from prompts or documents
Craft effective AI prompts tailored for business contexts

why_now.industry_shift: AI is moving from standalone chat interfaces directly into daily work applications.
why_now.ai_impact: Copilot reduces hours of manual drafting and data formatting to minutes.
why_now.business_demand: Companies are investing heavily in Copilot licenses and need staff who can actually use them efficiently.
why_now.career_opportunity: Early adopters of AI productivity tools hold a massive competitive advantage.

learning_outcomes: PROMPT: Craft highly effective instructions for AI assistants
GENERATE: Professional content and presentations instantly
ANALYZE: Data and extract insights using conversational AI
AUTOMATE: Routine communication and meeting summarization

stages.focus: Learning how to talk to AI

stages.name: Ideation
stages.desc: Drafting initial concepts in Word via Copilot

stages.name: Analysis
stages.desc: Querying data in Excel to support ideas

stages.name: Presentation
stages.desc: Converting Word docs to PowerPoint slides automatically

business_use_cases.business_problem: Too much time spent on drafting routine reports and emails
business_use_cases.approach: Use Copilot to generate first drafts and summarize long email threads

ai_integration.ai_can_automate: Slide creation from text, meeting notes
ai_integration.ai_cannot_replace: Fact-checking, finalizing business strategy, nuanced communication
ai_integration.validation_protocol: Strict review of AI-generated data and text for hallucinations
ai_integration.responsible_use: Understanding data security boundaries within Microsoft 365

best_practices: Always review and edit AI-generated content before sharing
Provide context and clear constraints in prompts
Use Copilot to overcome blank page syndrome, not to finalize work

common_mistakes.mistake: Accepting Excel Copilot insights without checking the math
common_mistakes.professional_approach: Verify formulas generated by Copilot against raw data

career_paths.what_student_demonstrates: Ability to execute tasks 3x faster using AI tools

freelance_applications.client_workflow: Receive brief -> Generate drafts via AI -> Human refinement -> Final delivery
freelance_applications.portfolio_requirements: Examples of AI prompts and the resulting refined output

what_you_will_build: A comprehensive Business Proposal generated via AI
A Data Insights Report extracted conversationally
A Corporate Presentation converted from a document
final_deliverables: A portfolio of AI-augmented business documents and the prompts used to create them

assessment.criteria: Quality of prompts, accuracy of AI refinement, and final document professionality

certification.title: Certified Microsoft Copilot Specialist
certification.criteria: Successful completion of all AI-generation assignments

not_covered: Building custom Copilot plugins or Azure OpenAI development

faq.question: Do I need a special license for this course?
faq.answer: Yes, you need access to a Microsoft 365 account with a Copilot license.

faq.question: Is this just ChatGPT in Word?
faq.answer: Copilot has access to your Microsoft Graph (emails, files, chats), making it much more context-aware for business than standard ChatGPT.

faq.question: Will AI take my job?
faq.answer: AI won't take your job, but someone using AI might. This course ensures you are the one using AI.
